label: Part B: test against ground truth
class_prompt:
This satellite image was taken after a disaster. A red box marks one building.
How damaged is the building in the red box?
- Intact: undisturbed; no sign of water, structural or roof damage, or burn marks.
- Damaged: partly burnt, water or volcanic flow around it, roof elements missing, visible cracks, or partial wall or roof collapse.
- Destroyed: scorched, completely collapsed, partly or completely covered with water or mud, or no longer present.
Answer with one word: Intact, Damaged or Destroyed.
grade_prompt:
This satellite image was taken after a disaster. A red box marks one building.
Give the EMS-98 damage grade of the building in the red box, from Grade 1 (negligible to slight damage) to Grade 5 (destruction).
Answer with the grade only, for example: Grade 3.
